title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E9 — Everything's Coming Up Roses
Everything is coming up roses on Martha's Bedford farm; Martha is creating a brand-new rose garden with almost 200 roses; from color to fragrance, the inspired world of roses is a very good thing.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E10 — Azaleas, Hostas, and Wild Birds
Martha's azalea grove is bursting with the last flowers of spring; then everything you need to know about hostas; Martha takes up bird watching.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E11 — Martha's Garden Tours of Turkey Hill and Bedford
Martha visits her former home, Turkey Hill, where everything began for Martha in the 1970s; then back to her Bedford farm for a garden club tour - a peek inside Martha's gardens past and present.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E12 — Color For All Seasons
One of the joys of gardening is planning for beautiful color all through the year; bulbs and tubers are at the center of this show because of their beautiful blooms from spring to winter.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E1 — Martha's Easy Foundation Landscaping Project
Martha redesigns the foundation landscaping around one of the homes on her Bedford Farm, providing step-by-step instructions on how to complete a successful landscaping project with ease and intent.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E5 — Flour Power
Custardy-herb quiche with a malty rye crust; blueberry coffee cake with muesli topping; a seeded quick bread.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E7 — Yeasted Breakfast Favorites
Hazelnut hot cross buns with dried cherries; honeyed whole-wheat bread; pull-apart whole-wheat monkey bread.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E9 — Bakery-Style Cookies
Farro chocolate-chunk cookies; spelt-nut crescents with toasted nuts; whole-wheat almond butter sandwich cookies; granola cookies.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E10 — Naturally Gluten-Free
Italian-inspired cornmeal cake; spiced pumpkin pie with a crisp rice crust; flourless chocolate-walnut torte.

title: Martha Bakes
description:

Honey-wheat Parker House rolls; whole-wheat pita bread; molasses-oat bread.

title: Martha Bakes
description:

A classic roulade made with oat flour and berry cream; gluten-free chocolate buckwheat torte; zucchini-almond cake with cream cheese frosting.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S10 E1 — Adorned Cakes
Three celebration cakes -- a berry chiffon cake, a confection-topped caramel chiffon cake and a woodland stump cake.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E4 — Stocks
Three common stocks -- chicken, beef and vegetable.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E5 — Butchering
Master class on meat with fourth-generation butcher Evan Lobel includes cutting up a whole chicken, spatchcocking a Cornish game hen, butterflying a leg of lamb, butchering a beef tenderloin and making medallions from a pork loin.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E8 — Steaming
Cooking chicken breasts in parchment paper; cleaning and steaming mussels; using a bamboo steamer to prepare steamed salmon and peas.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E9 — Roasting
Roast chicken; roasted root vegetable salad; green peppercorn-crusted roast tenderloin of beef.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:

Using poached chicken breast in chicken salad sandwiches and Cobb salad; poached salmon steaks; poached eggs.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School

French fries; pan-fried chicken; Japanese tempura vegetables with dipping sauces.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E1 — Perfect Roast
Rib roast; crown roast of pork; stuffed turkey breast; the best cuts for roasting.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E2 — Stewing
The basic elements of making a stew; beef stew; veal stew; coq au vin.
